hypothesis: V78 and partial V79/V80 results show restoring control variance can remove correct DE calls. Test the opposite decoder direction: contract V66 residuals toward the library-scaled bulk expectation, then enforce exact parent row/gene sums and CPM mean. Related to earlier dispersion tuning, but controls actual published V66 margins. This is a noise-calibration diagnostic, not a claim that low biological variance is realistic.
proposal: Initial=(1-gamma)*X+gamma*library*bulk; gamma .25/.50. Negative control uses gamma -.25/-.50 and clips negative proposals before the same projection. No treatment values fitted; no learned source coefficients. All genes receive the same global temperature. Fixed count sums protect raw bulk/PDS; uncertainty-corrected MSE may change.
selection: First2 unique cases/context. Exact profiles/PDS and CPM<=.0005; FID gain>=.002, JAC>=baseline-.0005, REACH>=baseline-.005, available-study NMAE<=1.01; genuine FID/JAC better than opposite noise expansion. Highest FID, tie JAC. This separately specified opposite-direction hypothesis does not promote failed V78/V79/V80 candidates.
confirmation: Remaining20 cases both seeds0/620000; no reselection, same guards. A zero-response null test must additionally show no material increase in false DE calls before any production release. All reused public biology; no hidden overall forecast.
